reader.requirement: At 85 a CALL in a program must activate any program directly contained in that program (by literal or identifier), the directly contained program taking precedence over a separately compiled program of the same name (§1985:II.6.4.1.3), while a non-common program contained only indirectly is not reachable that way (SR4).

edition-consulted.switches: below 2002 a bare CALL target word is only identifier-1; a literal or data-name target binds as at 2023
refuses CALL ... AS NESTED (call-as-phrase-2002) at 85, so BinderDriver#NestedCallablesOf is never consulted at 85
refuses PROGRAM-ID RECURSIVE (program-id-recursive-2002) at 85, so ResolveVisible's self-call arm is unreachable

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|CobolVersion|Dialect|ConstructRegistry in ProgramTable.cs, ProgramNameScope.cs, CallBinder.cs: ResolveVisible's rule 1 (direct children of the caller) reads no edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f02_01 covers one directly contained program called by literal; not exercised: an identifier target, a second-level containment, the name shadowing a separately compiled program, and the indirectly contained refusal

probes.printed: C1 / GC / DUP SEPARATE / C2 / DUP CONTAINED / GC NOT VISIBLE (MATCH)
probes.expected: main calls children C1 (literal) and C2 (identifier); C1 calls its own child GC; main's SR2DUP is its contained one, C1's SR2DUP is the separately compiled one (§1985:II.6.4.1.3); main's CALL of grandchild GC is not located (SR4) and takes ON EXCEPTION

probes.printed: error COBOL0900: the CALL ... AS phrase (program-prototype format) requires COBOL-2002 (targeting COBOL-85)
probes.expected: CALL ... AS NESTED is not 1985; refused

probes.printed: error COBOL0885: PROGRAM-ID RECURSIVE requires COBOL-2002 (targeting COBOL-85)
probes.expected: 1985 PROGRAM-ID has no RECURSIVE attribute; refused

OK  §1985:II.6.4.1.2 SR4  (6.4.1.2 Scope of the CALL Statement)  the text is in SR4

reader.notes: ResolveVisible's first arm walks only the caller's direct children before the outermost arm, so direct containment wins and an indirectly contained non-common program is not reached. No edition is read on the run-time path; the edition reads on the bind path only refuse 2002 forms.

refuter.evidence: Same rdup probe (runs/rdup-001, MATCH): RA's CALL of its directly contained COMMON RDUP activates the contained one, and a directly contained name wins over the separately compiled duplicate; a grandchild is not reached from the outermost (SR4), the call falling to the separately compiled program of that name. The reader's 2002 refusals (CALL ... AS, PROGRAM-ID RECURSIVE) stand. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:II.6.4.1.2 SR4  (6.4.1.2 Scope of the CALL Statement)  the text is in SR4' (quote 'if, and only if, that program is directly contained within the calling program').
